content.title: BioUrja Renewables Evacuation Order Lifted After Bomb Disposal
content.caption: BioUrja Renewables, an ethanol production plant, was evacuated after a bomb threat was found. The evacuation was lifted after explosives were rendered safe.

slides.heading: Bomb Threat at BioUrja Renewables
slides.text: A bomb threat was found at BioUrja Renewables, an ethanol production plant in Peoria, Illinois. The evacuation order was implemented to ensure public safety.

slides.heading: Evacuation Order Lifted
slides.text: After explosives were rendered safe, the evacuation order was lifted. The plant was reopened and residents were allowed to return to their homes.
